title: The same classic payment under three node-flag profiles
pattern: The same ledger as written by a node with base flags, with Galexie's six flags, and with none. The ledger is identical; the metadata is not: with no flags the classic transfer event and the fee events are absent and LedgerCloseMeta has no ext v1.

hazards.placement: LedgerCloseMetaExt v1 under base and galexie flags, v0 under bare

facts.says: With base or Galexie flags the payment emits one transfer event.
With no flags it emits none.
With no flags LedgerCloseMeta ext is v0.
The ledger header hash is identical under all three profiles: the same ledger.
